situations.headline: JAL Retail Entitlement Offer opens at $0.035, non-renounceable dilution round

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: JAL Retail Entitlement Offer opens at $0.035, non-renounceable dilution round (interest 3, risk 6)

thesis.text: JAL remains a small-cap speculative ASX issuer executing a non-renounceable entitlement offer to raise modest retail capital (~A$1m) at $0.035/share, alongside a larger institutional tranche and placement, diluting existing holders via new shares and Alignment Options [asx:09b66cea5c19c21321815d3fc77e6bc7 p.1-2]. Absent operational detail in this filing, the raise appears purely a funding event; monitor use-of-proceeds disclosure and subsequent Appendix 3B filings for dilution quantification and shareholder base shifts.
